policies.title: 53 African ordinary passports: Kyrgyz Republic Tourist eVisa
policies.summary: The live MFA eVisa application's controlling nationality gate directly returned Tourist (TS) for every queued passport-country ID. After that positive gate, the same session's ordinary-passport Tourist response says the visa is issued for tourism for up to 30 days; the MFA portal requires eVisa confirmation through the portal before entry.
conditions: Fresh-session gate replay used the exact application selector IDs MU=141, ZA=205, BW=29, LS=125, NA=153, MA=150, SZ=213, GH=85, KE=116, MW=133, TZ=219, GM=82, RW=184, TN=226, ZM=246, CV=41, MZ=151, UG=231, SL=199, BJ=24, ST=194, ZW=247, BF=36, CI=57, MG=132, SN=196, NE=161, TG=222, GA=81, GN=94, MR=140, GQ=69, ML=136, TD=44, GW=95, DZ=4, KM=52, AO=7, CM=39, CG=53, LR=126, CF=43, BI=37, EG=67, CD=54, DJ=63, NG=162, ER=70, LY=127, SS=207, ET=72, SD=210 and SO=204. Each POST to getList7 returned Tourist (TS).

Only after that positive gate, each ordinary-passport replay used ids=56 (Tourist), doc_type=1 (Ordinary), visa_filtr=1 (Single Entry) and service_level=2. All 53 getVisaList_2 responses said Tourist visa (TS) is issued for tourism for a period up to 30 days; the live form labels service level 2 as consideration within 2 business days.

Complete the online eVisa application and receive the electronic confirmation through the portal before entry. The portal's public two-business-day text describes expedited consideration, not a guaranteed standard decision time.

The electronic visa is usable only through Manas International Airport, Osh International Airport or Ak-dzol checkpoint. The service requires the ordinary passport to meet its document rules; work, residence, transit, diplomatic, service/official, other-document, security and individual admission decisions are outside this short-visitor policy.

application.label: Kyrgyz Republic eVisa application
application.processingTime: The live form offers expedited “Consideration of the application within 2 business days”; it does not promise a standard decision time.
steps: Before travel, select the passport country, Ordinary, and the positive Tourist (TS) option in the MFA eVisa application.
Complete the electronic application, pay and receive the eVisa confirmation through the portal before travel.
Use the confirmed eVisa at Manas International Airport, Osh International Airport or Ak-dzol checkpoint, subject to normal admission checks.

conflicts.explanation: The live MFA eVisa gate selected South Africa's exact country ID 205 and returned Tourist (TS). The subsequent Ordinary (doc_type=1) tourist replay said the visa is issued for tourism up to 30 days, while the portal requires electronic confirmation before entry. No airport-issuance evidence was used.
